arxiv-2204-13593.title: Operational Optimization to Maximize Dynamic Range in EXCLAIM Microwave Kinetic Inductance Detectors Journal: Journal of Low Temperature Physics
arxiv-2204-13593.creator: Trevor M. Oxholm 1, Eric R. Switzer 2, Emily M. Barrentine 2, Thomas Essinger-Hileman 2, James P. Hays-Wehle 2, Philip D. Mauskopf 3, Omid Noroozian 2, Maryam Rahmani 2, Adrian K. Sinclair 3, Ryan Stephenson 3, Thomas R. Stevenson 2, Peter T. Timbie 1, Carolyn Volpert 4, Eric Weeks 3
arxiv-2204-13593.description: Abstract Microwave Kinetic Inductance Detectors (MKIDs) are highly scalable detectors that have demonstrated nearly background-limited sensitivity in the far-infrared from high-altitude balloon-borne telescopes and space-like laboratory environments. In addition, the detectors have a rich design space with many optimizable parameters, allowing high sensitivity measurements over a wide dynamic range.

arxiv-2206-09813.title: Evolutionary rationality of risk preference
arxiv-2206-09813.creator: Song-jia Fan, Yi Tao, Cong Li
arxiv-2206-09813.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Song-jia Fan, Yi Tao, Cong Li. Significance

Risk does not discriminate. It tests all individuals with the
uncertain future consequences of present actions, regardless of
species or intelligence. And selection takes place in the process
ever since ancient time. The kinds of risk attitude that survived
evolution must be rational in the sense that they adapt to different
intensity of selection in order to maximize the winning chance of their
carriers.

arxiv-2311-17824.title: Depth-multiplexing spectral domain OCT for full eye length imaging with a single modulation unit Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2311-17824.creator: Guanghan Meng * †, Andrew Zhang *, Fabio Feroldi, Austin Roorda, and Laura Waller †
arxiv-2311-17824.description: Abstract Measuring the axial length of the eye is emerging as a crucial approach to measure progression and monitor management of myopia. The high cost of current swept-source OCT devices, the preferred method for such measurements, limits their broad use, especially in lower-income communities.

arxiv-2408-15562.title: Boosting Lossless Speculative Decoding via Feature Sampling and Partial Alignment Distillation
arxiv-2408-15562.creator: Lujun Gui, Bin Xiao, Lei Su, Weipeng Chen
arxiv-2408-15562.description: Abstract Lossless speculative decoding accelerates target large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model for generating tree-structured candidates, which are subsequently verified in parallel by the target LLM. Currently, effective approaches leverage feature-level rather than token-level autoregression within the draft model to facilitate more straightforward predictions and enhanced knowledge distillation.

arxiv-2504-16401.title: Stability threshold of Couette flow for 3D Boussinesq system in Sobolev spaces
arxiv-2504-16401.creator: Shikun Cui, Lili Wang, Wendong Wang
arxiv-2504-16401.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shikun Cui, Lili Wang, Wendong Wang. In this paper, we investigate the nonlinear stability and transition threshold for the 3D Boussinesq system in Sobolev space under the high Reynolds number and small thermal diffusion in 𝕋 × ℝ × 𝕋 \mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{T} .

pmc-10562219.title: The Posterior Cranial Vertical Line: A Novel Radiographic Marker for Classifying Global Sagittal Alignment
pmc-10562219.creator: Paul J. Park, Fthimnir M. Hassan, Xavier E. Ferrer, Cole Morrissette, Nathan J. Lee, Meghan Cerpa, Zeeshan M. Sardar, Michael P. Kelly, Stephane Bourret, Kazuhiro Hasegawa, Hee-Kit Wong, Gabriel Liu, Hwee Weng Dennis Hey, Hend Riahi, Jean-Charles Le Huec, Lawrence G. Lenke
pmc-10562219.description: ObjectiveTo define a novel radiographic measurement, the posterior cranial vertical line (PCVL), in an asymptomatic adult population to better understand global sagittal alignment.MethodsWe performed a multicenter retrospective review of prospectively collected radiographic data on asymptomatic volunteers aged 20–79. The PCVL is a vertical plumb line drawn from the posterior-most aspect of the occiput.

pmc-10641752.title: TMEM106B reduction does not rescue GRN deficiency in iPSC-derived human microglia and mouse models
pmc-10641752.creator: Sara L. Dominguez, Benjamin I. Laufer, Arundhati Sengupta Ghosh, Qingling Li, Gaia Ruggeri, Maheswara Reddy Emani, Lilian Phu, Brad A. Friedman, Wendy Sandoval, Christopher M. Rose, Hai Ngu, Oded Foreman, Mike Reichelt, Yves Juste, Guita Lalehzadeh, Dennis Hansen, Helle Nymark, Denia Mellal, Helene
pmc-10641752.description: SummaryHeterozygous mutations in the granulin (GRN) gene are a leading cause of frontotemporal lobar degeneration with TDP-43 aggregates (FTLD-TDP). Polymorphisms in TMEM106B have been associated with disease risk in GRN mutation carriers and protective TMEM106B variants associated with reduced levels of TMEM106B, suggesting that lowering TMEM106B might be therapeutic in the context of FTLD.

pmc-10675315.title: Exploring an Unknown Corner of a Well-Known Topic: HIIE Influence on Renal Health and Filtration in Healthy Individuals Free of Cardiometabolic Diseases
pmc-10675315.creator: Jeffrey S. Forsse, Kathleen A. Richardson, Ricardo Torres, Catherine Lowry, James Kyle Taylor, Cassidy L. Beeson, Jacob Ward, Anurag Dhillon, Brock Niceler, Ahmed Ismaeel, Panagiotis Koutakis
pmc-10675315.description: Aerobic exercise, specifically high-intensity interval exercise (HIIE), and its effects on renal health and filtration (RHF) are not well understood. Several studies support incorporating contemporary biomarkers serum cystatin C (CyC) and urine epidermal growth factor (uEGF) to combat the volatility of serum creatinine (sCr).

pmc-11046592.creator: Ching Cheng Daniel Hsieh, A Daniel Pearl, Emma Wesley
pmc-11046592.description: ients and arrange for PEG placement if appropriate. PEG tubes are placed by two consultant endoscopists with a combination of local anaesthetic (LA) spray and fentanyl. Methods We retrospectively reviewed the records of all MND patients referred for consideration of PEG placement between January 2019 and October 2022.

pmc-11344308.title: Extracellular vesicle-bound VEGF in oral squamous cell carcinoma and its role in resistance to Bevacizumab Therapy
pmc-11344308.creator: Jiasheng Zhou, Xue Liu, Qi Dong, Jiao Li, Weidong Niu, Tingjiao Liu
pmc-11344308.description: BackgroundVascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) is an important proangiogenic factor and has been considered as a key target of antiangiogenetic therapy in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC). However, clinical application of bevacizumab, a specific VEGF antibody, didn’t improve the survival rate of OSCC patients.

pmc-11465124.title: Hovering flight regulation of pigeon robots in laboratory and field
pmc-11465124.creator: Zhengyue Zhou, Yezhong Tang, Rongxun Li, Wenbo Wang, Zhendong Dai
pmc-11465124.description: SummaryCompared to traditional bio-mimic robots, animal robots show superior locomotion, energy efficiency, and adaptability to complex environments but most remained in laboratory stage, needing further development for practical applications like exploration and inspection. Our pigeon robots validated in both laboratory and field, tested with an electrical stimulus unit (2-s duration, 0.5 ms pulse width, 80 Hz frequency).

pmc-12506040.title: Naturally occurring mutations in envelope mediate virulence of Usutu virus
pmc-12506040.creator: Megan B. Vogt, Jeffrey M. Marano, William J. Hanrahan, Seth A. Hawks, Anne M. Brown, Sheryl Coutermarsh-Ott, James Weger-Lucarelli, Nisha K. Duggal
pmc-12506040.description: Usutu virus (USUV) is a mosquito-transmitted flavivirus that is closely related to West Nile virus. Recently, USUV emerged in Europe, where it has caused multiple bird die-off events and neuroinvasive disease in humans. Previously, we showed that USUV isolates from Africa cause significantly more severe disease than European isolates in mice.

pmc-12591062.title: Ultra-thin (<2 µm) silicon carbide free-standing membranes as beam position monitors for soft and tender X-ray beamlines
pmc-12591062.creator: E. Medina, G. Trovato, L. Calcagno, S. Kalbfleisch, M. Birri, G. Milluzzo, F. Romano, E. Sangregorio, S. Moscato, F. M. Milian, S. Giordanengo, A. Vignati, M. Camarda
pmc-12591062.description: The use of ultra-thin (<2 µm) silicon carbide membranes as in-line beam intensity and position monitors for soft and tender X-ray beamlines is investigated. Experimental results and theoretical simulations highlight the limitations of four-quadrant sensor designs, and alternative solutions for high-resolution and minimally interfering beam monitoring are proposed.

pmc-13051248.title: Advanced Competencies for Endoscopy Nurses: A Rapid Review of Current Practices and Training Approaches
pmc-13051248.creator: Andrea Minciullo, Daniela Tartaglini, Lucia Filomeno, Riccardo Grande, Dhurata Ivziku
pmc-13051248.description: As endoscopy procedures expand in scope and technology, endoscopy nurses find themselves requiring advanced competencies that span both technical skills and clinical knowledge. This review aims to identify the key advanced competencies for nurses in endoscopy, addressing competencies that optimize patient outcomes and the efficacy of endoscopic procedures.

pmc-13441555.title: The Past, the Present, and the Future of Periostin in Allergy
pmc-13441555.creator: Kenji Izuhara, Satoshi Nunomura, Yasuhiro Nanri, Yuko Honda
pmc-13441555.description: Periostin is a matricellular protein that binds to its receptors, which include several integrin molecules but mainly αvβ3 integrin on cell surfaces, thereby transducing its signals into cells. Almost 20 years have passed since we found that periostin is involved in the pathogenesis of asthma, which marked the first evidence of its involvement in allergic diseases.

pmc-13579050.title: Concomitant parathyroid hormone-secreting oncocytic adrenocortical carcinoma and parathyroid adenoma
pmc-13579050.creator: Natalie A Moreno, Amir H Hamrahian, Christian F Meyer, Ciera Mangone, Ezra Baraban, Lilah F Morris-Wiseman
pmc-13579050.description: A 53-year-old man underwent resection of a nonfunctional 9 cm oncocytic adrenal cortical carcinoma (ACC) with focal high-grade features. Two years later he presented again, with gynecomastia and elevated levels of estradiol, 11-deoxycortisol, and serum calcium (10.5 mg/dL, SI: 2.62 mmol/L) (reference range 8.4-10.2 mg/dL [SI: 2.10-2.55 mmol/L]). Imaging demonstrated locally recurrent ACC, which was resected.

pmc-13604770.title: The Use of Adjunct Therapies with Surgery for Gastroenteropancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumors: Indications, Timing, and Outcomes
pmc-13604770.creator: Kathryn Cavallo, Naris Nilubol
pmc-13604770.description: Background/Objectives: Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) are rare biologically heterogeneous neoplasms but with increasing incidence in recent years. Surgery remains the backbone of treatment; however, long-term recurrence is common even after curative resection. Despite expanding treatment options, the optimal perioperative integration of adjunct therapies in conjunction with surgery remains incompletely defined, as available evidence is largely retrospective and heterogeneous.
